d.description: the duration of the last/ current session (lastSessionDuration)

em.description:
the end minute of the day of the session/ the rule
which created this session (endMinuteOfDay)

l.description: the timestamp of the last usage of this session (lastUsage)

md.description: the maximum duration of a session (maxSessionDuration)

sm.description:
the start minute of the day of the session/ the rule
which created this session (startMinuteOfDay)

spd.description: the pause duration after a session (sessionPauseDuration)
